name: terse-rules

claimed.text: none: these are Trove's own rules and no savings figure is claimed for them
claimed.label: claimed

prompt_tokens.label: measured
prompt_tokens.text: no clear reduction in prompt tokens per request between on and off sessions yet

cost.label: measured
cost.text: sessions with the tool on cost more than sessions with it off, beyond what chance explains; sessions differ, so review before concluding

evidence: Sessions with the tool on are compared with later sessions without it. Sessions differ in size and task, so this supports a conclusion but does not prove it.
rolled_back: Trove switched terse-rules off because sessions with it on cost $1.5200 each on average against $1.0200 without it (25 on, 25 off sessions), so it was costing more than it saved.
